plugins.name: task-observer
plugins.description: Turns the corrections and repeated workflows of your work sessions into small, reviewed skill updates: every change comes with its evidence and a written reason, and nothing touches a skill until you approve and install it.

plugins.name: task-observer-flush
plugins.description: Turn-end guard for task-observer (experimental): notes a turn that used tools and wrote nothing to the observation log or checkpoints.log, and reminds the next turn to flush.
